gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (loan mid-vowel [eː], in ar-LY inventory). Tripoli frame نِبِّي 'I want' + تَوّ 'now' (pereira2011eall). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي laptop جْدِيد بَسّ wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕindiː labtub ˈʒdiːd ˈbass wifi bɑˈtˤɪːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); wifi→wifi. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: we have to do an update for the program
notes: [tech] update→abdat. Tripoli 1pl نَعْمْلُوا. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl. Genitive exponent مْتَاع mtāʕ (benkato2020). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/ realised [dʒ], unlike native ǧīm→[ʒ] in Tripoli — pereira2011eall). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I saw a nice video online
notes: [daily] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]); online→unlin. Frame بْنِين 'nice' Maghrebi register (benkato2020). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: فِي offer بْنِينَة وْ discount كْبِير هَلْبَة
raw: في offer بنينة و discount كبير هلبة
ipa: fiː ufa ˈbniːna w disawnt ˈkbiːr ˈhalba
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a very big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt. Intensifier هَلْبَة 'very', hallmark Libyan (pereira2011eall). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: delivery يُوصَل غُدْوَة وْ الدَّفْع cash
raw: delivery يوصل غدوة و الدفع cash
ipa: dilifiri ˈjʊːsˤɑl ˈɣudwa w adˈdafʕ kaʃ
gloss_en: delivery arrives tomorrow and payment is cash
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari; cash→kaʃ. غُدْوَة 'tomorrow' Maghrebi (benkato2020). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: وَدِّيت الْكَرْهَبَة garage عَلَى خَاطِر engine
raw: وديت الكرهبة garage على خاطر engine
ipa: wadˈdiːt alˈkarhaba ɡaradʒ ˈʕalaː ˈxɑːtˤɪr inɡin
gloss_en: I took the car to the garage because of the engine
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (/ɡ/ in ar-LY inventory, final /ʒ/→[dʒ] loan); engine→inɡin. كَرْهَبَة 'car' Libyan lexeme; عَلَى خَاطِر 'because of'. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: this model is new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik. Demonstrative هَاذَا (interdental retained in eastern-type spelling; Tripoli reads stop). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَنَا think هَاذَا model غَالِي هَلْبَة
raw: أنا think هاذا model غالي هلبة
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaːdaː mudil ˈɣaːliː ˈhalba
gloss_en: I think this model is very expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (/θ/ RETAINED, unlike Cairene tink — pereira2011eall keeps interdentals available); model→mudil. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نْشُوفَك فِي weekend إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak fiː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. Frame نْشُوفَك 'we see you' + إِنْ شَاءَ الله. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the car is empty, I have to fill it with petrol
notes: [automotive] Italian loan بَنْزِينَة 'petrol' < It. benzina; attested Libyan [banˈziːna] (pereira2010; benkato2020 on the Italian loan stratum). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: Italian-contact loan into ar-LY (benkato2020 p.201)

gloss_en: I have to change the water pump
notes: [automotive] Italian loan طُرُمْبَة 'pump' < It. tromba; attested Libyan [tˤˈrumba] (pereira2010). Pipeline matches. table: Italian-contact loan into ar-LY (benkato2020 p.201)

gloss_en: put the food on the table
notes: [daily] Italian/Romance loan طَاوْلَة 'table' < It. tavola; attested pan-Maghrebi/Libyan [ˈtˤaːwla] (benkato2020). Pipeline matches. table: Italian-contact loan into ar-LY (benkato2020 p.201)

gloss_en: mum is in the kitchen cooking the food
notes: [daily] Italian loan كُوجِينَة 'kitchen' < It. cucina, with native ǧīm→[ʒ] (Tripoli sun-letter ǧīm, pereira2011eall; the Italian /ʒ/-loan stratum, benkato2020 p.201 grīǧū). Attested [lkuːˈʒiːna]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits lkuˈːʒiːna — stress mark misplaced inside the length mark (ˈ before ː). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: Italian-contact loan into ar-LY (benkato2020 p.201)

sentence: نْشُوفَك السِّيمَانَة الْجَايَة إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك السيمانة الجاية إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak assiːˈmaːna aˈlʒaːja ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: see you next week, God willing
notes: [daily] Italian loan سِيمَانَة 'week' < It. settimana; attested Libyan/Tunisian [siːˈmaːna] (pereira2010; benkato2020). PIPELINE WRONG: emits assiˈjmaːna — inserts a spurious glide [j] and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: Italian-contact loan into ar-LY (benkato2020 p.201)

ipa: ˈʕindiː miːˈʕaːd ˈmaʕa ddaˈktuːr aˈssaːʕa ˈtisʕa
gloss_en: I have an appointment with the doctor at nine
notes: [daily] Arabizi (3arabi): 3=ع. Spells عِنْدِي مِيعَاد مَعَ الدَّكْتُور السَّاعَة تِسْعَة. Pipeline has no Arabizi path (arbtok.translit never sniffs a Latin run as Arabic); ipa is the Tripoli reading of the spelt sentence (Pereira (2010) Le parler arabe de Tripoli; Pereira (2011 EALL) Tripoli Arabic; Benkato (2020) Maghrebi Arabic p.201)

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday? I didn't find you
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 7=ح, g=Tripoli qāf→[ɡ] (pereira2011eall g-dialect). Spells وِين مْشِيت الْبَارِح مَا لْقِيتِكْش (ma-…-š circumfix negation). unsupported (no Arabizi path); ipa = Tripoli reading (Pereira (2010) Le parler arabe de Tripoli; Pereira (2011 EALL) Tripoli Arabic; Benkato (2020) Maghrebi Arabic p.201)

ipa: ˈsˤbaːħ alˈxiːr ˈjaː ħaˈbiːbiː ˈkiːf ˈsˤɑħħtak
gloss_en: good morning dear, how is your health
notes: [daily] Arabizi (7abibi style): 7=ح, 77=صحّ (geminate ħ). Spells صْبَاح الْخِير يَا حَبِيبِي كِيف صَحّْتَك. unsupported; ipa = Tripoli reading (Pereira (2010) Le parler arabe de Tripoli; Pereira (2011 EALL) Tripoli Arabic; Benkato (2020) Maghrebi Arabic p.201)
